title: Real MultiSWAP N:1 + live MODFLOW6 end-to-end application qualification
predecessors: F-GC40 typed deterministic N:1 MultiSWAP affine cell response
F-GC44 real one-column/one-cell SWAP + live MODFLOW6 application
goal: Qualify one real N:1 runtime composition in which two independently transactional real FMR/SWAP columns contribute area-weighted exchange to one live MODFLOW6 6.8.0 cell through the admitted F-GC40 affine cell response and F-GC41 publication ordering.
reconcile_findings: F-GC40 already canonically owns the deterministic N:1 affine reduction at a common groundwater-cell reference head.

F-GC25 already provides architectural precedent for all-tile preflight before sequential SWAP/ledger publication, but its groundwater participant predates the F-GC38/F-GC41 live MODFLOW prepared-solve lifecycle.
F-GC44 provides the real FMR participant, real accepted-trajectory predictor, live MODFLOW prepared solve and single-participant publication evidence.
No new soil-water or groundwater physics is required for a two-column N:1 application qualification.
The new decision surface is composition and publication across multiple independently transactional real SWAP participants sharing one irreversible MODFLOW timestep publication.
design_decisions: Start with two real FMR columns and one live MODFLOW cell; use distinct SWAP lineage ids and explicit area fractions summing to one.
Build one admitted F-GC30 predictor response per real SWAP column and reduce them with F-GC40 at one explicit common groundwater reference head.
At each corrector iteration run both real SWAP columns from their own immutable accepted checkpoints at the same MODFLOW cell head; compare MODFLOW realized flux with the area-weighted SWAP flux.
Discard every nonfinal candidate for every tile before the next coupling iteration.
Before the first irreversible publication operation, require non-mutating readiness for every retained SWAP candidate, every prepared tile ledger and the live MODFLOW timestep.
Publication order remains F-GC41: finalize MODFLOW timestep once, then commit all preflighted SWAP candidates in canonical tile order, then commit all prepared ledgers.
A post-publication SWAP/ledger failure is a durability/invariant failure, not rollback-safe retry, matching the existing F-GC25/F-GC41 boundary.
Qualification is runtime/composition evidence only; it makes no scientific claim that heterogeneous unsaturated-zone columns may be replaced by one equivalent column.

initial_envelope.topology: two real SWAP columns -> one MODFLOW cell
initial_envelope.tangent: one analytic accepted-trajectory response per tile; F-GC40 aggregate slope
initial_envelope.publication: all-tile preflight before MODFLOW finalize_time_step; canonical tile-order SWAP commits then ledger commits

exclusions: more than one live MODFLOW groundwater cell
next_permitted_action: Implement a qualification-only same-process two-real-FMR/one-live-MODFLOW harness reusing F-GC40 and F-GC44 production surfaces. Add no production code unless the harness exposes a concrete missing reusable seam.
